protocol:
1. Place labeled microcentrifuge tubes in a green ice bucket and keep them chilled on the bench next to an Invitrogen E-Gel EX agarose gel cassette, an E-Gel Power Snap electrophoresis unit, a white tube rack, sterile pipette tips, and an adjustable micropipette.

2. Attach a sterile disposable pipette tip from the tip box to the adjustable micropipette.

3. Remove a labeled microcentrifuge tube from the ice bucket, open the cap, and mix the liquid sample by pipetting up and down with the micropipette.

4. Close the mixed microcentrifuge tube and place it into the white tube rack.

5. Repeat the mixing step for additional labeled microcentrifuge tubes from the ice bucket, using the micropipette to mix each liquid sample.

6. Place the prepared microcentrifuge tubes into the white tube rack after mixing.

7. Hold the Invitrogen E-Gel EX agarose gel cassette on the bench and load liquid sample from a prepared microcentrifuge tube into a gel well using the micropipette.

8. Load additional liquid samples into separate wells of the E-Gel EX agarose gel cassette with the micropipette.

9. Insert the loaded E-Gel EX agarose gel cassette into the E-Gel Power Snap electrophoresis unit.

10. Close the amber lid of the E-Gel Power Snap electrophoresis unit over the gel cassette.

11. Start the electrophoresis run by pressing the front control screen/button on the E-Gel Power Snap unit and leave the gel cassette running with the on-screen timer displayed.
